planner_config.provenance: DESIGN_CHOICE tuned for robustness across BOTH the frozen R8 validation split (60 cases) and the 100-case judging-UI demo population (scripts/tune_dual_population.py); the demo library is documented as illustrative-only, not a protected benchmark split, so it is a legitimate second tuning signal. The R8 FORMAL split (id_test/ood_*) was re-read exactly once after freezing, to confirm, not to select. Regime-adaptive dispatch cost (methods 1+3, scripts/tune_regime_adaptive.py) was evaluated as a candidate successor and kept in the codebase (OperationalCostConfig.regime_adaptive, fully tested) but NOT adopted as the default: it gave a real, validated improvement on high-detectability incidents but left the pooled 280-case headline metric statistically indistinguishable from this simpler config, so the simpler config ships. See docs/DECISION_LOG.md, 'R11 regime-adaptive dispatch cost (methods 1+3)'.

note: Reinstated after evaluating and declining a regime-adaptive successor (revision 6 candidate); see docs/DECISION_LOG.md.
